Healer/burst-I utility: her damage is the 10s-CD skill2 hit + the burst nuke; her healing is the recovery-EVENT channel only (v1 has no HP pool — heal amounts are never numbers here, by engine convention). || FULL-KIT AUDIT (every line accounted for): S1 'Refresh Heart' is a StateEffect, BOTH ■ lines trigger 'when the last bullet hits the target'. (S1a) heal the 1 ally with the lowest HP% for 4.45% of the caster's final Max HP = IMPLEMENTED lastBullet → alliesLowestHp(1) → heal. No HP pool: the heal primitive emits the recovery event channel only (the amount is unmodeled by construction, same convention as helm/crown); 'lowest HP%' resolves to the LEFTMOST ally (documented v1 stand-in, types.ts alliesLowestHp — indeterminate without an HP pool). Observable exclusively through on-recovery consumers (crown's 'when recovery takes effect'). (S1b) 'Refresh Heart: Incoming healing ▲ 6.53%, stacks up to 5, lasts 15 sec' = SPLIT: the stack COUNT is load-bearing — the burst's conditional heal gates on 'Refresh Heart at max stacks' — so the stacks are IMPLEMENTED as the `refreshHeart` resource pool (initial 0, max 5, +1 per lastBullet). The 6.53% incoming-healing MAGNITUDE has no StatKey and no HP pool to act on — genuinely unrepresentable, verbatim in unmodeled. The kit's 15s stack duration is approximated as no-lapse: at her ~8.4s SG mag-dump cadence the applications beat the window, so under refresh-on-reapply semantics the stacks ramp to 5 by the 5th magazine and never lapse while she keeps firing — behavior-identical in scope; diverges only if she stops firing for >15s (⚑3). (S2) 'Vitamin Power' has NO activation clause in the ■ header → pure internal timer: the datamined skillCooldownsSec.skill2 = 10s is the firing cadence → interval:10 → flatDamage 160 vs the enemy (single boss = trivially the highest-final-ATK enemy), first fire t=10 (the 2026-07-20 skill-cooldown convention; helm-aquamarine precedent) ⇒ 17 hits/180s. 'ATK ▼ 3.55% for 5 sec' on that enemy = UNMODELED — no enemy-ATK debuff primitive exists (damageTakenPct is a DIFFERENT mechanic: boss-takes-more, not boss-ATK-down) and the boss's ATK feeds nothing in v1 (the boss deals no modeled damage); purely defensive. (Ba) 1237.5% of final ATK as Burst Skill damage to the highest-final-ATK enemy = IMPLEMENTED burstCast → flatDamage 1237.5 (burst-cast auto FB-exempt: the cast lands BEFORE the Full Burst window opens — verified fact 2026-07-13; snapshots pre-FB; crit-eligible at the sheet rate by the flatDamage default; single boss takes the full value). (Bb) 'all allies: increases stack count of stackable buffs by 1' = the SELF slice is modeled as the `refreshHeart` resource increment (clamped at 5) ordered BEFORE the gated heal block (the kit's ■ bullets resolve in listed order; blocks dispatch sequentially per frame, so a cast at 4 stacks completes 5 and heals on THAT cast — pinned by the spec). The GENERIC cross-unit clause (every stackable buff on every ally) is now modeled via a separate addStack count:1 block targeting all allies. (Bc) 'when Refresh Heart is at max stacks → all allies: heal 27.22% of the caster's final Max HP' = IMPLEMENTED burstCast + resourceGate{refreshHeart ≥ 5} → allies heal (recovery channel; amount unmodeled like all heal amounts). Fires on every pepper burst from the cast that completes 5 stacks (~4th–5th magazine onward); earlier casts stay silent — the gate is load-bearing, an ungated model over-fires every on-recovery consumer early. || ⚑ FLAGS (all unmeasured): (1) CADENCE TUPLE — ALWAYS-⚑: SG pullsPerSec class default 1.5 + reloadFrames 142 + ammo 9, all datamine; a ~15–20% mag-dump-cadence swing moves the P1 heal cadence, the stack ramp timing and hence the burst-gate transition. burst: Restores HP equal to 27.22% of the skill user's final Max HP. — magnitude only: the HP amount has no engine consumer (no HP pool), so the number is unmodeled; the recovery EVENT is modeled (heal, skill1/burst slots), which is the board-relevant half — on-recovery consumers read the event, never the amount.
